call_chain.update: UIMainMidCtrl.Update calls UpdatePlayerAtrbute every frame while GameUI.Instance.mMainPlayer is set and MainMid is active.
call_chain.slider: mComfort_4.sliderValue = ComfortMax <= 0 ? 0 : Comfort / ComfortMax; no lerp.
call_chain.fall: m_CurComfort = Comfort; if it is above m_lastComfort, store it; else if m_lastComfort - m_CurComfort > m_ComfortFallValue, start the curve (m_CurvePlay, m_CurveTotalTime = 0) and store it; else store it. The comparison is with the previous frame only.
call_chain.curve: While m_CurvePlay: m_CurveTotalTime += Time.deltaTime; mComfortForeground.alpha = mComfortAlphaCurve.Evaluate(m_CurveTotalTime); stop once that alpha >= 1. The alpha is never otherwise written.
call_chain.face: sliderValue < 0.2 face3, < 0.5 face2, else face1; reassigned with MakePixelPerfect only when the name changes.
call_chain.hide: GameUIMode.HideMode (building) calls mUIMainMidCtrl.Hide; UIStaticWnd.OnHide deactivates MainMid itself because mWndCenter is null, so Update stops until ShowMode.

scope: Source presentation of the Adventure HUD comfort bar, face and drop flash. Not a comfort simulation.
limitations: UISlider and UIFilledSprite are in the compiled NGUI firstpass assembly, not decompiled: the fill is drawn with the shared scissor adapter and the slider value is clamped to 0..1 as an adapter.
AnimationCurve.Evaluate is native; C evaluates these keys with the float Hermite polynomial used for attack playback, a bounded arithmetic adapter not separately qualified for this curve.
Which code recreates GameUI on a load or a menu return is compiled (PeFlowMgr); the C reset on load is a native lifecycle adapter.
PeGameMgr.gamePause is compiled; freezing the presentation clock while paused or unfocused is a native adapter.
Widget alpha reaches the vertex colour through NGUI; C rounds alpha*255.
Rects are the reference 1280x720 canvas; the hide tween's exact frame is not modelled.
